items: Exact date and route of the first train journey in India (16 April 1853, Mumbai to Thane over 34 km) are repeatedly tested in RRB NTPC & Group D exams.
Questions matching Railway Zones with their Headquarters (e.g., Central Railway – Mumbai CSMT, South Eastern Railway – Kolkata) are highly frequent.
Identify the 18th and newest Railway Zone: South Coast Railway headquartered at Visakhapatnam.
Know Project Unigauge, which aims to convert all Meter Gauge and Narrow Gauge tracks into 1.676 m Broad Gauge.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The first passenger train in India ran between Bori Bunder (Mumbai) and Thane on April 16, 1853.
Indian Railways was nationalized in 1951 and is currently the fourth-largest national railway system in the world by size.
The entire rail network is administratively divided into 18 zones, with the South Coast Railway Zone (Visakhapatnam) being the 18th zone.
Bholu, an elephant holding a signal lamp and dressed as a guard, is the official mascot of Indian Railways.
The Fairy Queen is recognized by the Guinness Book of World Records as the world's oldest working steam locomotive.
